Ministry of Health - Manatū Hauora
@minhealthnz
Dec 21, 2025
Our latest Health Survey shows hazardous drinking among people aged 15+ has decreased from 21.3% in 2019-2020 to 16.6% in 2024-2025.
With the holiday period coming, it’s a timely reminder that alcohol use can impact health and wellbeing.
